run_prepare_data_2d_h36m_generic: run the script to convert 2D pose detections from Human3.6M mp4.npz files into a compressed npz dataset
build_convert_2d_detections: build a 2D keypoints dataset from subject directories containing mp4.npz files with camera indices
test_suggest_pose_importer: test the suggest_pose_importer function to select the correct importer for a given output suffix
test_suggest_metadata: test the suggest_metadata function to retrieve joint count and metadata for a given output suffix
summarize_cam_map: summarize the camera ID to index mapping used to assign camera positions in the output dataset
